Almost all of us have gotten lag at one point or another, so here are some tips that I've found over the internet that will help prevent FPS Issues and/or Crashes. Note that none of these are foolproof ways to prevent the game from acting up, but are good places to start.

  1. Always use save as (create new save files instead of using an existing one)
  2. Restart computer before playing or after playing the game for over two hours.
  3. Use NRaas Overwatch
  4. Use EllaCharmed Routing Fixed Worlds
  5. Clear the Game Cache Files, World Caches (PC Only,) and Thumbnails.
  6. Keep your computer clean and defrag regularly (HD Only)
  7. Combine .packages (CC Only)

These are only a few of the ways I keep my game running as well as it can. Don't hesitate to add any tips I didn't cover in the comments.
